a-bomb: a nuclear weapon in which enormous energy is released by nuclear fission (splitting the nuclei of a heavy element like uranium 235 or plutonium 239)
a-horizon: the top layer of a soil profile; usually contains humus
a-line: women's clothing that has a fitted top and a flared skirt that is widest at the hemline
a-list: a list of names of specially favored people
a-team: a group of elite soldiers or a leadership group of advisors or workers in an organization
